command:
set -euo pipefail
echo IDENTITY_HOST=$(hostname)
echo IDENTITY_USER=$(id -un)
echo CHECKOUT_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo SERVICE_BEGIN
systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost -p ExecStartPre
echo SERVICE_END
[[ "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value)" == inactive ]] || { echo SERVICE_NOT_INACTIVE >&2; exit 71; }
[[ "$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)" == 0 ]] || { echo SERVICE_PID_NONZERO >&2; exit 72; }
echo SOURCE_VERIFY_BEGIN
sudo -n python3 /home/andreas/self-integration/werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py verify
echo SOURCE_VERIFY_END
echo INSTALLED_CONDITION_BEGIN
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py condition
echo INSTALLED_CONDITION_END
echo MANIFEST_BEGIN
sudo -n python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json')
o=json.loads(p.read_text())
print('schema='+str(o.get('schema')))
print('required_binds='+json.dumps(o.get('required_binds'), sort_keys=True))
print('database_count='+str(len(o.get('databases',[]))))
for i,r in enumerate(o.get('databases',[])):
 print(f'db[{i}].source={r.get("source")}')
 print(f'db[{i}].destination={r.get("destination")}')
 print(f'db[{i}].logical_sha={r.get("logical",{}).get("sha256")}')
 print(f'db[{i}].rows={json.dumps(r.get("logical",{}).get("row_counts",{}), sort_keys=True)}')
PY
echo MANIFEST_END
echo BINDS_BEGIN
sudo -n grep '^ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf
echo BINDS_END
echo SOURCES_BEGIN
for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do sudo -n test -f "$p" || { echo SOURCE_MISSING=$p >&2; exit 73; }; sudo -n stat -c 'SOURCE=%n BYTES=%s MTIME=%Y' "$p"; done
echo SOURCES_END
echo DURABLE_QUICKCHECK_BEGIN
for p in /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/agentzero/welt.db /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do sudo -n test -f "$p" || { echo DURABLE_MISSING=$p >&2; exit 74; }; printf 'DURABLE=%s QUICK=' "$p"; sudo -n sqlite3 -readonly "$p" 'PRAGMA quick_check;'; done
echo DURABLE_QUICKCHECK_END
echo FINAL_STATE=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState --value) FINAL_PID=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
echo READBACK_PASS=1
